Can you see dolphins from Koh Samui? | Yes, on a boat trip. Indo-Pacific humpback (pink) dolphins feed off the Khanom coast, about 45 minutes by speedboat from Thong Krut, and our Pink Dolphins and Pig Island tour (2,250 THB) goes to look for them. They are wild, so sightings are likely on calm days but never guaranteed.
Are there dangerous snakes on Koh Samui? | Venomous snakes such as cobras and pit vipers occur in southern Thailand, but visitors rarely see them and bites are uncommon. Wear closed shoes on trails, use a torch at night, back away from any snake, and for a bite keep the person still, immobilise the limb and call 1669.
Are there monkeys on Samui? | Wild troops are rarely seen in Samui's tourist areas. Ang Thong Marine Park has dusky leaf monkeys and long-tailed macaques; don't feed them or carry food openly. Macaques you see on Samui are usually trained coconut-picking or captive animals, and we advise skipping monkey shows.
Is there a tiger zoo on Koh Samui? | Samui Aquarium and Tiger Zoo had no confirmed opening in 2026, and captive tigers kept for visitor contact raise serious welfare concerns. We don't list or recommend it; see wildlife at sea and in Ang Thong Marine Park instead.
Where is the best reef near Koh Samui? | For easy snorkelling, Koh Tan on the Pig Island trip (all year) and Ang Thong's fringing reefs (16 December–31 October). For the clearest water, Koh Nang Yuan by Koh Tao; for big fish and occasional whale sharks, Sail Rock, best for divers.
Are the elephant camps on Koh Samui ethical? | Some are and some aren't. Choose a sanctuary with no riding, no bathing with tourists, no shows and no chained animals, where you observe and feed from a safe position; those are the only elephant visits we sell. Avoid chained elephants at roadside viewpoints.
~What do I do about a jellyfish sting? | Get out of the water, pour household vinegar over the sting for at least 30 seconds, don't rub it or rinse with fresh water, and call 1669 for an ambulance if there is pain spreading, breathing difficulty or confusion. Box jellyfish are rare but potentially fatal.
Are stray dogs dangerous on Koh Samui? | Most beach dogs are calm, but packs can be territorial at night on quiet roads. Don't feed or approach them, walk calmly, and after any bite or scratch wash the wound for 15 minutes and go to a hospital the same day for rabies treatment.
Is it legal to collect shells or coral on Koh Samui? | Not in national parks such as Ang Thong, where taking anything is prohibited, and buying or exporting coral, turtle shell and protected-wildlife products is illegal in Thailand. Leave shells and coral where you find them.
Can we see turtles near Koh Samui? | Occasionally. Green and hawksbill turtles are on Ang Thong's records, but sightings on day trips are rare, and turtles are rarely seen at Koh Tan. If you see one, keep your distance and never chase or touch it.
